summary: Comprehensive testing of Cortexia Optical Agenda Module with 3 views (Daily, Weekly, Monthly) completed successfully. Backend: 15/15 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All UI flows working correctly including view switching, navigation, appointment creation, and status changes.

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent} - accessibility improvement recommended (same as previous iterations)

backend: GET /api/appointments?date=future returns empty for future date
DELETE /api/appointments/{id} cancels appointment (sets status to cancelada)
POST /api/appointments works for all types (consulta, examen, control, entrega)
GET /api/appointments returns sorted by date and time
frontend: Agenda page loads with daily view by default
View switcher tabs (Dia/Semana/Mes) visible and functional
Daily view shows time slots from 08:00 to 17:30
Daily view shows appointments in correct time slot with patient name
Weekly view shows 7-day grid (Mon-Sun) with day headers
Weekly view shows compact appointment cards
Monthly view shows full month calendar
Monthly view shows appointment counts per day
Clicking day in monthly view switches to daily view of that day
Clicking day header in weekly view switches to daily view
Navigation arrows (prev/next) navigate correctly per view mode
Hoy button returns to current date
Header label changes format per view (daily: full date, weekly: range, monthly: month year)
Status legend shows all 4 statuses (Pendiente, Confirmada, Completada, Cancelada)
Nueva Cita dialog opens with all form fields
Nueva Cita dialog - patient selection works
Nueva Cita dialog - date picker works
Nueva Cita dialog - time selection works
Nueva Cita dialog - type selection works
Nueva Cita dialog - duration selection works
Create appointment saves and shows success toast
Appointment dropdown menu shows Confirmar/Completar/Cancelar options
Confirmar status change works with success toast

context_for_next_testing_agent: Agenda module fully tested with 3 views. Backend supports both single date (date param) and date range (date_from, date_to params) queries. Frontend uses data-testid attributes: view-daily, view-weekly, view-monthly for tabs; nav-prev, nav-next for navigation; today-btn for today button; month-day-YYYY-MM-DD for monthly calendar cells; appointment-{id} for appointment cards. Status values: pendiente, confirmada, completada, cancelada. Appointment types: consulta, examen, control, entrega.
